== Biography ==

== Trivia ==
* His ID '''huanfeng''' is his given name (Huan-Feng).
* He was abandoned by his parents at the age of 12.
* Became known for his play on {{ci|Jhin}} at the [[2020 World Championship]], especially after a play against [[JD Gaming]] in the knockout stage quarter-finals where he flanked the opposing team by using Jhin's ultimate from inside their base. 
* Broke the LPL record for percent damage to champions with {{ci|Jinx}} on Apr 6, 2021. He did 66.2% of his team's total damage to champions.
* Reached 1000 kills in the LPL on June 21, 2022.
** The 32nd player to reach 1000 kills in the LPL.
